title: MCP schema-rejected arguments from a wrong type or an unknown action name the field they concern
outcome: MCP schema-rejected arguments from a wrong type or an unknown action name the field they concern
acceptance: In ordinary engram mcp, a tool call whose argument has the wrong type (for example next with peek set to a string) or an action word that does not exist is refused with text that names the offending field (for example `peek` or `action`), not only the bad value or the expected type; a real-stdio test pins the field name for both cases
The rejection still reaches no word and keeps isError true; the docs, MCP instructions and engram-use skill describe the delivered wording without promising more

completion.summary: In ordinary engram mcp, an argument refused for a wrong type, an unknown action or an undeclared field now names its field (a nested one by path) after the unchanged "failed to deserialize parameters:" prefix, still an isError text result before any word runs; an Engram-local Parameters extractor uses serde_path_to_error 0.1.20 and keeps tools/list byte-identical. Landed in ca558a5.
